title: chlorocyperus glomeratus
intro: Chlorocyperus glomeratus, commonly known as Marsh Club-rush, is a type of sedge plant native to tropical regions. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include its use in treating various health issues. The health benefits of Chlorocyperus glomeratus include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of reducing pain, inflammation, and fever. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
